title: Mixed Event — The Sounds of a Summer Festival! — Episode5 Shibuya Summer Festival!

meta.Event: The Sounds of a Summer Festival!
meta.Event Outline: Akito and Toya are invited to perform at the Summer Festival's live concert as a substitute act. Back when Akito had lost sight of his goals after facing setbacks in soccer, he and Ena witnessed that very same event...

rows.Line: A few days later
Park

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Wow, you guys are getting really good at this!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I mean, we've been practicing every day...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Also, we're exaggerating each move quite a bit, but what we're doing isn't all that difficult.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Based on our time budget until the event, we chose to focus on how we look on stage as opposed to what we actually do.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Oh, I see!
I need to keep trying too then...!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: When we practiced in SEKAI that other time, I thought your moves were coming along pretty well too.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Wait, you think so?!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I think so too.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Hehe. Thanks!
Let's practice together again sometime!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, that'd be nice.
Maybe once more just before the event or something.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right. I feel like we're able to learn more about ourselves when you're there with us, Len.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Great! I can't wait!>
Shinonome Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: *Yawn*... So sleepy...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I'm beat. I guess we did practice pretty late today...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Dinner... Nah, forget it. I'll just take a bath and go to bed.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, Akito, you're back.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm home.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
What happened?
You look a little dazed.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm fine.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, before I forget...
Mom said she bought some pudding.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Pudding?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: If you don't want any, I'll just take yours too.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I didn't say that.
I'll have one...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Okay, okay...
I guess they say that sweets are the best cure for being tired.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm not that tired or anything...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
*Yawn*...
Anyway, I'm getting pretty sleepy, so I'm going to bed.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
You should go to bed soon too.
Night.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I will. Night.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Do I really look that tired...?
The day of the Summer Festival
Summer Festival Fairgrounds

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Whoa, this is so cool!
So many food stalls!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Yakisoba, caramel apples...
Everything looks delicious!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Len, keep it down.
I don't want to find out what's gonna happen if someone sees you.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<I know...
But this is my first time coming to a Summer Festival like this!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Me too.
It's like the School Festival but feels much grander.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Hey, since we're here, why don't we check out what we can?!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, I'd like that too. It could be fun.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Fine... Once we're done performing, alright?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We can buy some stuff here and take it over to SEKAI to share with everyone else.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Yay! I'll choose what to take!
Oh, chocolate-dipped bananas might be good!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, alright. We can look later. For now, we have somewhere to be.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Right! But promise we'll go back, okay?>
Summer Festival Stage

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(So this is it.
It seemed a lot bigger when I came here with Ena that one time.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (It looks a lot smaller now.)

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: Thanks so much for doing this, you guys! Everyone else is rehearsing right now, so it'll be just a few more minutes.

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: You can leave any valuables in the lockers by the gates, and any large objects can... Oh, sorry, you'll have to use one of these boxes for the time being...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's fine. This box should work.

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: Great! I'll be looking forward to your performance!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Everybody's so busy rehearsing.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Well, yeah. Anyway, I'm gonna put some stuff in this box. Got anything you need to store, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I don't have much in terms of luggage, so I'll just put what I have in one of those lockers.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(But there's so many people...
I'd hate to get in the way of something, so I guess I can leave my shoes here too.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay, let's close these two boxes up and leave them off to the side somewhere.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Sure, that may be best since so much equipment is still being moved around.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Wow, you can see the whole festival from here! This stage is set up a lot better than I was expecting!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Whoa, Len! You've gotta be more careful when you do that!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Don't worry, I am!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <You said that this is the amateur division, but the singing groups and dance teams rehearsing right now look really good!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, they should be considering how famous they all are.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Oh, I didn't know that!
But you guys are the headliners for this event, so that's gotta feel good, right?>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, we're just subbing in for someone else.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But that's also why we have to give this crowd a good performance. We're gonna turn this event on its head.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I'd have it no other way.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <And I'll be cheering for you guys!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, let's do one last check before our turn to rehearse comes around.
Hm? Is that...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It is you! Hey, Akito!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I didn't expect to run into you in a place like this! It's been a while!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Momoi...? What brings you here?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We passed by after finishing practice and decided to check it out.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, also... This is Shizuku. We're a part of the same idol group.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm Shizuku Hinomori. It's very nice to meet you. Airi's become such an invaluable friend to me.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Did you really have to add that last part?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's nice to meet you too. I'm Akito Shinonome. My sister's already told me a little about you and the picnic you both went on the other day.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Shinonome...?
Does that mean you're Ena's little brother?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yes, that's correct...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You really are! Ena's told me all about you, and I'm so glad we finally had a chance to meet!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Haha... That's nice.
Oh, right. This is my partner, Toya.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Toya, these are my sister's friends, Momoi and Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: My name is Toya Aoyagi. It's very nice to meet you both.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Nice to meet you too, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We formed a team together and have been performing in events for some time now.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Wait, you have?!
Does that mean you're in this one too...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yes, a friend of mine asked us to be in it.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wow, that's great!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's wonderful! Airi and I were just talking about seeing the concert too.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you. We hope you do.
We promise to put on a good performance as well.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I'll be looking forward to it!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, is Ena not with you?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, her...? She said that she'd be here but I think she's with some of her other friends.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, okay.
It'd be nice to bump into her while we're here. Right, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I have a feeling that we may just run into her somewhere on the fairgrounds.

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line:
Akito! Toya!
There's something I need to check with you before your rehearsal. Mind heading over to the stage?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, sure.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Sorry for keeping you.
Good luck with your event!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We'll see you later!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yes, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Shall we head over to the stage?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Summer Festival Committee Member A
rows.Line: Hey, am I supposed to move this box that was off to the side too?

rows.Speaker: Summer Festival Committee Member B
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's going to the HQ tent!
It's darker than I expected, so we need to get as many lights set up now as we can.

rows.Speaker: Summer Festival Committee Member A
rows.Line:
Got it. Up you go...!
Hm? This feels a lot lighter than a box of extension cords should...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay, now to wait until the show starts.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <You guys dancing got me so worked up! I can't wait!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Me too. I can't wait to get up on stage.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Then why don't we switch into our other shoes? That box should be...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What's wrong?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No way... They're gone.

rows.Speaker: Toya & Len
rows.Line: What?
